question: ____________, popularly known as Punjab Kesari took his last breath on November 17th, 1928
solution:
The correct answer is **__Lala Lajpat Rai.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lala Lajpat Rai **was an **Indian author, freedom fighter, and politician**. He played a vital role in the Indian Independence movement.
 
• Lala Lajpat Rai was known as** 'Punjab Kesari'** because **of his fierce acts of protest against the British and his contributions to achieving freedom.**
 
• He helped in establishing a few schools in the country. 
 
• He also initiated the foundation of the **Punjab National Bank**.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information​__**

 
• **Dadabhai Naoroj**i is also known as the **"Grand Old Man of India"** and **"Unofficial Ambassador of India",** and was an Indian political leader, merchant, scholar and writer.
 
• **Swami Vivekananda** was an **Indian Hindu monk, philosopher and author**. He was a chief disciple of the 19th-century Indian mystic Ramakrishna.
 
 
• His original name **Narendranath Datta.**
 
 
 
• Bal Gangadhar Tilak was the **first leader of the**** **Indian independence movement.
 
 
• The British colonial authorities called him "**The father of the Indian unrest**". 
 
• He was also conferred with the title of "***Lokmanya***", which means "accepted by the people as their leader". 
 
• Mahatma Gandhi called him "**The Maker of Modern India**".
